study_identification_part.si_4_title: Multiscale Heterogeneity of White Matter Morphometry in Psychiatric Disorders

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study used 14 independently acquired datasets from 25 scan sites. Named/recognizable datasets include: ABIDE I (sites: CALTECH, CMU, LEUVEN_1, MAX_MUN, NYU, PITT, SBL, USM) for ASD; ABIDE II (sites: BNI, IU) for ASD; IMpACT-NL for ADHD; ASRB (sites: BRIS, MELB, PERT, SYDN) for SCZ; TOP15 for BP and SCZ; HCP (S900 release, n=150 unrelated subjects) for independent normative diffusion tractography. Additional datasets without standard catalog names include FEMS (First Episode Mania Study) for BP, MON (Monash Cohort) for HC, OCDPG for OCD, SPAINOCD for OCD, KANMDD for MDD, MITASD for ASD, RUSMDD for MDD, WASHASD for ASD, and YoDA for MDD. Because the study integrates >=10 distinct datasets, it qualifies as MULTI-DATASET.

"normative connectome estimated in an independent, healthy, unrelated cohort of 150 diffusion-weighted MRI scans (71 male, aged 21-35 years) from the S900 release of the Human Connectome Project (HCP150)"
